title: Learning-Theoretic Foundation for General Coded Computing: The Adversarial Setting
abstract: arXiv:2610.27440v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial workers pose a severe challenge in distributed computing systems by returning corrupted outputs that can substantially distort the recovered computations. Coded computing addresses this threat by introducing redundancy across worker assignments. Existing exact and approximate coded-computing methods typically handle adversarial outputs by explicitly locating and correcting or removing erroneous evaluations, which adds significant computational overhead at the master node. Moreover, existing analyses do not characterize how the recovery error scales with the number of workers and the adversarial budget.   In this paper, we develop an adversarially robust extension of general coded computing (GCC), a learning-theoretic approximate coded-computing framework that designs the encoder and decoder by minimizing an upper bound on the end-to-end recovery error. translated_title: 通用编码计算的学习理论基础：对抗性设定
translated_abstract: 对抗性工作节点会返回受损的输出，从而严重扭曲恢复出的计算结果，这给分布式计算系统带来了严峻挑战。编码计算通过在工作节点任务分配中引入冗余来应对这一威胁。现有的精确与近似编码计算方法通常通过显式定位并纠正或剔除错误的计算结果来处理对抗性输出，这会给主节点带来显著的计算开销。此外，现有分析未能刻画恢复误差如何随工作节点数量和对抗预算的变化而扩展。本文提出了通用编码计算（GCC）的一种对抗鲁棒扩展。GCC 是一个基于学习理论的近似编码计算框架，通过最小化端到端恢复误差的上界来设计编码器和解码器。所提出的方法并不通过识别受损工作节点来应对对抗，而是利用平滑……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文为基于学习理论的通用编码计算框架提出了对抗鲁棒的扩展，无需显式识别受损工作节点即可设计编码器与解码器，并刻画了恢复误差随工作节点数量和对抗预算变化的规律。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an adversarially robust, learning-theoretic extension of general coded computing that designs encoders and decoders to tolerate corrupted worker outputs without explicitly identifying malicious workers.
